ModMetaData.name: Medieval Overhaul - Recycle Only 1.5 v1.9
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Adds recycling only to Medieval Overhaul's existing mending bench. Recycle bills accept damaged or full-durability items. Recycle duration is controlled only by each RecipeDef's workAmount; durability, material, MaxHP, pawn work speed and bench speed do not affect duration. Completion dismantles the item into materials instead of repairing it.
